notes.title: Hello from the developer
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I’m Ilya Chernoknizhnikov, the developer of IntelRoach. I’ve finally gathered my thoughts and decided to write my first welcome message. This is my first full game, on which I’ve been working for just over a year—starting from a simple idea and now a project I really want to see through to release.

What’s already done:
    The game is basically complete, except for a few UX/UI tweaks and fixing some bugs we’ve caught.
    We’ve also run several rounds of closed testing and collected feedback.

What’s next:
    In the coming weeks, I plan to prepare the game trailer and kick off a larger-scale testing phase.

Expected release date: June 30, 2025

Let’s chat!
Post your questions, ideas, or just say hi in the comments! And if you’re excited, be sure to add the game to your Wishlist—your support keeps me motivated as we push toward launch.

Thanks for being with me—more updates soon!
